messages:
marta: Got woken up by 4 kv_cache flap pages between 02:10-02:30. All were ~45s spikes during an autoscaler burst. Need a fast mitigation and someone to own follow-ups.
daniel: looks like model_serving.kv_cache.flap again. Currently pages immediately on >4x region miss rate.
rebecca: short-term: flip immediate-page -> warning for blips <3m; keep page for sustained >=3m. Add 10m suppression keyed by fingerprint.
jake: +1. Also add a dedupe key by instance_id so retries from the same pod don't duplicate. I'll sketch the alert patch.
marta: owners: daniel -> small rule tweak + staging deploy; jake -> dedupe key PR; rebecca -> remediation ticket and runbook blurb. ETA: staging today, runbook 48h, dedupe PR next Tue.
daniel: opening PR now, will include a suppressed_events metric so we can count how many alerts got demoted to warnings.
oncall-bot: Staging deploy: prometheus/rules updated by daniel at 1799123600.
rebecca: RMD-4102 created: "kv-cache flap noise reduction". Tasks: 1) runbook paragraph about flap vs sustained (48h) 2) add suppressed_events metric (72h) 3) evaluate autoscaler churn (2w).
jake: PR: https://git.internal/repo/prom-alerts/pull/621 (dedupe + suppression label). unit tests included.
marta: plan to canary to two clusters at 04:00 UTC tomorrow. If green, full roll by 05:00 UTC.
daniel: will monitor pager volume during the canary window and post a short summary.
rebecca: also adding a one-liner to oncall playbook: "If you see single <2m kv-cache flaps without 5xx/latency spikes, treat as noise." Drafting now.
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: kv-cache follow-up sync 1799185200 (Fri 15:00 UTC) attendees: marta, daniel, rebecca, jake.
marta: after the Fri sync, rebecca to close RMD-4102 with final owners and dates.
daniel: monitoring tonight; will ping if anything unusual.
jake: thanks team. :thumbsup:
